overview_description.description: Calo is a direct-to-consumer food tech company offering personalised meal subscriptions. Its app automatically calculates the calories and macronutrients that users need and delivers them ready-to-eat meals portioned to fit their fitness goals. The app matches users with chef-prepared meals, ensuring high-quality food convenient for busy lifestyles. With its user-friendly interface, the Calo app allows users to analyze their needs and subscribe to meal plans in less than two minutes.

about_short_description.short_description: Calo is a D2C foodtech startup that serves personalized meal subscriptions by matching users with chef-cooked meals.

product.name: Personalized Meal Subscription Service
product.description: A subscription service that delivers chef-prepared meals tailored to individual nutritional needs, preferences, and goals using a nutritionist-approved algorithm.

product.name: Meal Customization Feature
product.description: A feature allowing users to build their own meals by selecting flavors and ingredients to create personalized dishes.

product.name: Flexible Subscription Management
product.description: Options for users to pause subscriptions, skip delivery days, or adjust meal plans to accommodate changing schedules and preferences.

product.name: 24/7 Customer Support via Live Chat
product.description: Continuous customer service support available through live chat to assist users with inquiries, issues, or feedback.

product.name: Weekly and Seasonal Menu Updates
product.description: A meal menu that is updated weekly and seasonally to offer a variety of dishes aligned with nutritional goals and preferences.

product.name: Free Delivery Service
product.description: A delivery service that provides free shipping of meals directly to customers' locations.
